webhooks.name: connection-llmisvc-v1alpha1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService resources (v1alpha1 and v1alpha2). It injects ConnectionsAPI credentials (S3 serviceAccountName and model URI, OCI imagePullSecrets, or plain URI) into the spec based on a connection annotation on the resource, and applies HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) from a referenced HardwareProfile CR. On updates it handles connection replacement/removal cleanup and surgical removal of previously-injected HardwareProfile values.

webhooks.name: connection-llmisvc-v1alpha2.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService resources (v1alpha1 and v1alpha2). It injects ConnectionsAPI credentials (S3 serviceAccountName and model URI, OCI imagePullSecrets, or plain URI) into the spec based on a connection annotation on the resource, and applies HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) from a referenced HardwareProfile CR. On updates it handles connection replacement/removal cleanup and surgical removal of previously-injected HardwareProfile values.

webhooks.name: minferencegraph-v1alpha1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Provides mutating defaults and validating admission control for KServe InferenceGraph v1alpha1 resources. The validator enforces that serviceURL references in graph node steps use only cluster-internal hostnames (.svc or .svc.<clusterDomain>) within the same namespace as the InferenceGraph, rejecting public hostnames and cross-namespace references to prevent data leakage (e.g. Authorization header) and enforce network security boundaries.

webhooks.name: minferenceservice-v1beta1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for KServe InferenceService resources. The validating webhook rejects creation when the name exceeds length limits or targets the protected applications namespace (from DSCInitialization). The mutating webhook injects connection credentials (S3 storage keys, URI storageUri, OCI imagePullSecrets) and HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) into the InferenceService spec based on annotations, and surgically cleans up previously-injected values on connection or profile removal.

webhooks.name: mutating.pod.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutates incoming Pods that have RAY_USE_TLS enabled (in kserve-container or worker-container) by injecting TLS volumes, volume mounts, and an init container that copies Ray TLS certificates from a shared Secret into the pod, enabling mTLS communication between Ray cluster nodes used for distributed inference serving.

webhooks.name: validating.isvc.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for KServe InferenceService resources. The validating webhook rejects creation when the name exceeds length limits or targets the protected applications namespace (from DSCInitialization). The mutating webhook injects connection credentials (S3 storage keys, URI storageUri, OCI imagePullSecrets) and HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) into the InferenceService spec based on annotations, and surgically cleans up previously-injected values on connection or profile removal.

webhooks.name: validating.nim.account.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates NIM Account creation by enforcing a singleton constraint: only one Account resource is allowed per namespace. On create, it lists existing Accounts in the target namespace and rejects the request if one already exists; updates and deletes are always permitted.

operator_config.name: AuthPolicyObjectiveExpressionAnnotation
operator_config.doc:
AuthPolicyObjectiveExpressionAnnotation is a Gateway annotation that allows customizing
the CEL expression used to compute the objective value for inference.
If not set, defaults to extracting the namespace from ServiceAccount usernames,
or "authenticated" for non-SA users.

operator_config.name: AuthUnavailable
operator_config.doc:
AuthUnavailable is logged in an Event when an InferenceGraph is configured to
be protected with auth, but Authorino is not configured.

operator_config.name: AuthorinoTLSBootstrapAnnotation
operator_config.doc:
AuthorinoTLSBootstrapAnnotation is a Gateway annotation that enables EnvoyFilter creation
for Authorino TLS bootstrap even when the gateway has opendatahub.io/managed=false.
This allows configuring TLS between the gateway and Authorino without creating AuthPolicies.
This is in particular useful for MaaS gateway where custom policies are used, but we still need
to configure TLS between the gateway and Authorino.

operator_config.name: DefaultObjectiveExpression
operator_config.doc:
DefaultObjectiveExpression is the default CEL expression for computing the objective value.
For ServiceAccount tokens, it extracts the namespace; for other users, it returns "authenticated".
